formats.ecsv: ECSV 1.0 (Astropy APE 6): CSV with a YAML header carrying datatype, unit, UCD and description per column
formats.votable: IVOA VOTable 1.5 TABLEDATA with a UCD and a VOUnits unit per FIELD

claimBoundary: Formats and metadata follow the IVOA documents named in each file; the content is the same retained public catalog projection as the JSON release, not an independent measurement. Source membership is not independent confirmation; nothing is averaged across sources.

objects.description: One row per WorldsIndex object (the catalog index): names, position, status, identity state, methods, sources and the population values the atlas selected, each with its source record id and limit flag.

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: Stable WorldsIndex object identifier (the key of the catalog index and the detail shards).

columns.name: name
columns.description: Preferred public designation in this release.

columns.name: host_name
columns.description: Host star or system name as the primary source states it.

columns.name: system_id
columns.description: WorldsIndex planetary-system identifier.

columns.name: ra_deg
columns.description: Source-retained right ascension (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: dec_deg
columns.description: Source-retained declination (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: healpix_8_nested
columns.description: HEALPix order 8 (nside 256) nested index of (ra_deg, dec_deg); empty without coordinates. Rows are sorted by it.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Normalized status: CONFIRMED, CANDIDATE, CONTROVERSIAL, FALSE_POSITIVE, REFUTED or UNKNOWN; the source-native status stays in the detail rows.

columns.name: identity_state
columns.description: Identity state under the pinned identity rules: CANONICAL, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS or UNREVIEWED.

columns.name: method_code
columns.description: Primary detection-method code (the method registry in registry.json.gz).

columns.name: method_codes
columns.description: Every detection-method code any source claims for the object, space-separated.

columns.name: discovery_year
columns.description: Discovery year as the primary source states it.

columns.name: discovery_facility
columns.description: Discovery facility as the primary source states it.

columns.name: primary_source_id
columns.description: Source whose record names and positions the object.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: Every source carrying a record for the object, space-separated. Membership is not independent confirmation.

columns.name: source_object_ids
columns.description: Source-native object identifiers linked to this object, space-separated.

columns.name: source_record_count
columns.description: Number of source record occurrences the atlas links to the object.

columns.name: detail_record_count
columns.description: Number of retained native catalog rows in the object's detail shard.

columns.name: spectrum_record_count
columns.description: Number of retained atmospheric-spectroscopy rows (source nasa-atmospheric-spectroscopy) in the object's detail shard.

columns.name: aliases
columns.description: Provider-stated aliases (NASA name tables), " | " separated; empty when none.

columns.name: orbital_period_days
columns.description: Orbital period; the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: orbital_period_days_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of orbital_period_days as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: orbital_period_days_source_id
columns.description: Source of orbital_period_days.

columns.name: orbital_period_days_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id orbital_period_days was read from.

columns.name: radius_earth
columns.description: Planet radius in Earth radii (IAU 2015 nominal 6378100 m); the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: radius_earth_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of radius_earth as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: radius_earth_source_id
columns.description: Source of radius_earth.

columns.name: radius_earth_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id radius_earth was read from.

columns.name: mass_earth
columns.description: Planet mass in Earth masses (IAU 2015 nominal, 5.9721679e24 kg); the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: mass_earth_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of mass_earth as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: mass_earth_source_id
columns.description: Source of mass_earth.

columns.name: mass_earth_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id mass_earth was read from.

columns.name: minimum_mass_earth
columns.description: Minimum mass (M sin i) in Earth masses; the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: minimum_mass_earth_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of minimum_mass_earth as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: minimum_mass_earth_source_id
columns.description: Source of minimum_mass_earth.

columns.name: minimum_mass_earth_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id minimum_mass_earth was read from.

columns.name: estimated_mass_earth
columns.description: Mass estimated by the source from a mass-radius relation, in Earth masses (not a measurement); the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: estimated_mass_earth_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of estimated_mass_earth as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: estimated_mass_earth_source_id
columns.description: Source of estimated_mass_earth.

columns.name: estimated_mass_earth_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id estimated_mass_earth was read from.

columns.name: eccentricity
columns.description: Orbital eccentricity; the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: eccentricity_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of eccentricity as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: eccentricity_source_id
columns.description: Source of eccentricity.

columns.name: eccentricity_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id eccentricity was read from.

columns.name: equilibrium_temperature_k
columns.description: Equilibrium temperature as the source states it; the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: equilibrium_temperature_k_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of equilibrium_temperature_k as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: equilibrium_temperature_k_source_id
columns.description: Source of equilibrium_temperature_k.

columns.name: equilibrium_temperature_k_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id equilibrium_temperature_k was read from.

columns.name: insolation_earth
columns.description: Insolation relative to Earth (dimensionless); the value of the one source row the atlas selected for this object (see the matching _source_record_id), never an average.

columns.name: insolation_earth_limit
columns.description: Limit flag of insolation_earth as the source carries it: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT.

columns.name: insolation_earth_source_id
columns.description: Source of insolation_earth.

columns.name: insolation_earth_source_record_id
columns.description: Stable source record id insolation_earth was read from.

measurements.description: One row per retained catalog value per publication: every source's own value, uncertainty, unit, limit flag and reference, keyed by the object and the native source record. Nothing is averaged or converted.

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: Stable WorldsIndex object identifier (the key of the catalog index and the detail shards).

columns.name: name
columns.description: Preferred public designation in this release.

columns.name: host_name
columns.description: Host star or system name as the primary source states it.

columns.name: ra_deg
columns.description: Source-retained right ascension (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: dec_deg
columns.description: Source-retained declination (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: healpix_8_nested
columns.description: HEALPix order 8 (nside 256) nested index of (ra_deg, dec_deg); empty without coordinates. Rows are sorted by it.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Source of the retained row.

columns.name: source_record_id
columns.description: Stable identifier of the retained native row (detail shard records[].sourceRecordId).

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: published solution (one publication), source composite (the source's own composite), mission candidate row or catalog row.

columns.name: is_source_default
columns.description: True when the source marks this row as its default parameter set; empty when the source has no such flag.

columns.name: property_code
columns.description: WorldsIndex property code (orbital_period, planet_radius, planet_mass, semi_major_axis, eccentricity, inclination, transit_midpoint, transit_duration, transit_depth, equilibrium_temperature, insolation, planet_star_radius_ratio, semi_major_axis_over_stellar_radius, impact_parameter, stellar_radius).

columns.name: source_field
columns.description: The source's own column the value was read from (its definition pointer).

columns.name: value
columns.description: Value exactly as the source states it, in unit. Units vary by row; never converted here.

columns.name: error_upper
columns.description: Positive uncertainty as the source states it (absolute value), in unit; empty when not stated.

columns.name: error_lower
columns.description: Negative uncertainty as the source states it (absolute value), in unit; empty when not stated.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Unit of value and its errors: a VOUnits string (d, h, K, deg, AU, solRad, 6378100m = Earth radius, 71492000m = Jupiter radius, 5.9721679e+24kg = Earth mass, 1.8981246e+27kg = Jupiter mass), empty for a dimensionless quantity, or percent / ppm for a transit depth the source states on that scale (not VOUnits).

columns.name: limit_type
columns.description: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT or UPPER_LIMIT from the source's own limit flag (NASA *lim: 1 lower, -1 upper); UNKNOWN_LIMIT for a flag outside that convention; empty when the source has no flag.

columns.name: mass_definition
columns.description: For planet_mass: MASS, MINIMUM_MASS_M_SIN_I or MASS_RADIUS_RELATION_ESTIMATE as the source provenance states; empty otherwise.

columns.name: time_system
columns.description: For transit_midpoint: the time system the source states (BJD_TDB; BKJD for Kepler KOI rows, BJD - 2454833.0); empty otherwise.

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Publication reference the source cites for the row (or, for a composite, for this value); empty when the source gives none.

columns.name: reference_url
columns.description: URL of that reference when the source gives one.

columns.name: published
columns.description: Publication date the source states for the row. ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

columns.name: updated
columns.description: Row update date the source states. ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

transit_ephemerides.description: One transit ephemeris per transiting planet, period and epoch from one cited catalog row (transit-ephemerides.json.gz).

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: Stable WorldsIndex object identifier (the key of the catalog index and the detail shards).

columns.name: name
columns.description: Preferred public designation in this release.

columns.name: host_name
columns.description: Host star or system name as the primary source states it.

columns.name: ra_deg
columns.description: Source-retained right ascension (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: dec_deg
columns.description: Source-retained declination (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: healpix_8_nested
columns.description: HEALPix order 8 (nside 256) nested index of (ra_deg, dec_deg); empty without coordinates. Rows are sorted by it.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Normalized status of the planet (CONFIRMED, CANDIDATE or CONTROVERSIAL).

columns.name: period_days
columns.description: Orbital period from the one cited catalog row.

columns.name: period_err_days
columns.description: Period uncertainty (the larger of the reported upper and lower errors, 1 sigma); empty when not reported.

columns.name: t0_bjd
columns.description: Mid-transit epoch from the same row, BJD_TDB unless time_system says otherwise.

columns.name: t0_err_days
columns.description: Epoch uncertainty (1 sigma); empty when not reported.

columns.name: duration_hours
columns.description: Transit duration as the row states it; empty when not reported.

columns.name: depth_ppt
columns.description: Transit depth in parts per thousand as the row states it (converted only in scale); empty when not reported.

columns.name: host_mag
columns.description: Host magnitude in host_mag_band; empty when not reported.

columns.name: host_mag_band
columns.description: V or TESS.

columns.name: time_system
columns.description: Time system of t0_bjd.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Source of the cited row.

columns.name: source_table
columns.description: Source table of the cited row (pscomppars, ps, toi, cumulative, k2pandc).

columns.name: source_record_id
columns.description: Stable identifier of the cited row.

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Reference the source cites for the row; empty when none.

columns.name: reference_url
columns.description: URL of that reference; empty when none.

columns.name: matched_via
columns.description: "tic+period" when a TOI row was attached to a NASA planet by TIC and period agreement; empty otherwise.

source_coverage.description: Per declared source: eligibility, attachment, the four denominators and the last recorded retrieval attempt (source-coverage.json).

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Source identifier in the WorldsIndex source universe.

columns.name: coverage_class
columns.description: ATLAS_INGESTED, FROZEN_CONTEXT, LIVE_PER_TARGET or NOT_CONFIGURED.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Source state in this release.

columns.name: snapshot_id
columns.description: Frozen snapshot the release read; empty when none.

columns.name: retrieved_at
columns.description: When that snapshot was retrieved. ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

columns.name: keyed_on
columns.description: Identifier kinds the source is keyed on, " | " separated.

columns.name: eligible
columns.description: Objects carrying an identifier of the kind the source is keyed on.

columns.name: attached
columns.description: Objects a row of the source reached by that exact identifier.

columns.name: missing_at_provider
columns.description: Eligible objects the snapshot holds no row for.

columns.name: blocked
columns.description: Eligible objects not looked up (no snapshot, no credential, or live-only).

columns.name: blocked_reason
columns.description: Why, in the words of the last recorded attempt when there is one.

columns.name: identifier_missing
columns.description: Objects with no identifier of a usable kind.

columns.name: rows
columns.description: Rows in the snapshot (or the ingested catalog).

columns.name: attached_rows
columns.description: Rows attached to objects in this release.

columns.name: via_cross_identifier
columns.description: Rows attached through an identifier another source stated.

columns.name: declared
columns.description: Four denominators (Professional Framework 4): in the versioned source universe.

columns.name: applicable
columns.description: Scientifically relevant and queryable for at least one object of this release.

columns.name: executed
columns.description: A bounded query, snapshot lookup or retrieval attempt occurred for this release; empty when the builder cannot know (live per-target sources).

columns.name: data_bearing
columns.description: Valid rows were returned and retained for at least one object.

columns.name: objects_declared
columns.description: Objects in the release (the declared denominator per source).

columns.name: objects_applicable
columns.description: Objects the source is applicable to (= eligible).

columns.name: objects_executed
columns.description: Objects a lookup was executed for; empty when not computable.

columns.name: objects_data_bearing
columns.description: Objects with retained rows (= attached).

columns.name: not_computable
columns.description: Which denominator the builder cannot compute for this source and why; empty when all four are computed.

columns.name: last_attempt_at
columns.description: When the follow-up last tried this source. ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

columns.name: last_attempt_outcome
columns.description: RETRIEVED, UNCHANGED, REFUSED, FAILED or SKIPPED_*; empty when none recorded.

columns.name: last_attempt_category
columns.description: Failure category of that attempt; empty when none.

columns.name: last_attempt_detail
columns.description: The provider's words or the follow-up's reason.
